_comment: Input for tools/sync_web_categories.py. categories -> category -> policy (block|monitor) -> list of sources. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Source types: {"inline": [...]}, {"file": "path"} (relative to this file), {"url": "https://..."} (plain or hosts-format list). Any source may set "enabled": false and "max_domains": N. Block rows are processed before monitor rows; the first category that lists a domain wins.

opnsense_unbound_blocklist._comment: Domains from Services > Unbound DNS > Blocklist (custom blocklist). Needs OPNSENSE_URL/KEY/SECRET. Off by default.
